name: es31-program-pipelines
title: Separable programs and program pipelines
summary: Separable programs (glCreateShaderProgramv, PROGRAM_SEPARABLE), program pipeline objects, run-time stage replacement with glUseProgramStages, glActiveShaderProgram vs glProgramUniform* (all 33 variants), glUseProgram precedence, location-based interface matching and glValidateProgramPipeline, with CPU-predicted pixels, state queries and the defined errors.
spec: ES 3.2 §7.3 Program Objects (glProgramParameteri PROGRAM_SEPARABLE, glCreateShaderProgramv, UseProgram, DeleteProgram)
ES 3.2 §7.4 Program Pipeline Objects (GenProgramPipelines, BindProgramPipeline, UseProgramStages, ActiveShaderProgram), §7.4.1 Shader Interface Matching, §7.4.2 Program Pipeline Object State
ES 3.2 §7.6.1 Loading Uniform Variables In The Default Uniform Block (Uniform* vs ProgramUniform*)
ES 3.2 §7.12 Shader, Program, and Program Pipeline Queries (GetProgramPipelineiv, GetProgramPipelineInfoLog)
ES 3.2 §11.1.3.11 Validation (ValidateProgramPipeline, VALIDATE_STATUS, INVALID_OPERATION at draw time)
GLSL ES 3.10 §4.4.1 Input Layout Qualifiers, §4.4.2 Output Layout Qualifiers, §4.4.3 Uniform Variable Layout Qualifiers, §9 Shader Interface Matching (9.2.1 footnote 2, 9.2.2 Separable Programs)

api.glCreateShaderProgramv: separable one-stage programs drive the pipeline cells (pixels); LINK_STATUS, PROGRAM_SEPARABLE, ATTACHED_SHADERS = 0; two source strings give the same picture as one; a compile failure returns a program with LINK_STATUS FALSE whose log contains the shader log; count < 0 -> INVALID_VALUE and 0
api.glProgramParameteri: PROGRAM_SEPARABLE set before glLinkProgram makes a two-stage program usable in glUseProgramStages (pixels, PROGRAM_SEPARABLE query); set after the link it is not honoured by Mesa (XFAIL documented)
api.glLinkProgram: LINK_STATUS of the two-stage separable program; a re-link after glProgramParameteri makes it separable
api.glGenProgramPipelines: names are not pipeline objects until first bound or used (glIsProgramPipeline)
api.glDeleteProgramPipelines: bound pipeline reverts to 0, IsProgramPipeline FALSE, unused/zero/already deleted names silently ignored
api.glBindProgramPipeline: the bound pipeline supplies the stages of draws (pixels), PROGRAM_PIPELINE_BINDING, INVALID_OPERATION for never generated and deleted names
api.glIsProgramPipeline: FALSE before first bind/use and for 0 and deleted names, TRUE after glBindProgramPipeline or glUseProgramStages
api.glUseProgramStages: replacing the vertex and the fragment stage of one bound pipeline changes the CPU-predicted pixels; VERTEX|FRAGMENT and ALL_SHADER_BITS with a two-stage program; program 0 clears a stage; GetProgramPipelineiv reports the programs; INVALID_OPERATION (non-separable, link failed, shader name, bad pipeline), INVALID_VALUE (unknown program)
api.glActiveShaderProgram: glUniform* reaches exactly the active program (glGetUniform readback, pixels), ACTIVE_PROGRAM query, program 0 -> no active program; INVALID_OPERATION/INVALID_VALUE cases
api.glValidateProgramPipeline: VALIDATE_STATUS TRUE for valid pairs (empty interface, same names, renamed outputs at the same locations), FALSE for location, type, precision and partial-multi-stage mismatches; draw with a FALSE pipeline raises INVALID_OPERATION, with a TRUE one does not; replacing the offending program makes the same pipeline valid
api.glGetProgramPipelineiv: ACTIVE_PROGRAM, VERTEX_SHADER, FRAGMENT_SHADER, COMPUTE_SHADER, VALIDATE_STATUS, INFO_LOG_LENGTH compared with the expected state after each step; INVALID_OPERATION for a never generated name
api.glGetProgramPipelineInfoLog: log length equals INFO_LOG_LENGTH - 1 (or 0); the partial-multi-stage log is printed
api.glProgramUniform1f: set on a program that is never current; the zoo cell turns green and glGetUniformfv reads it back
api.glProgramUniform3f: zoo cell + readback; tints and backgrounds of the pipeline cells (pixels)
api.glProgramUniform1fv: zoo cell + readback (array, partial array update)
api.glProgramUniform2i: zoo cell + readback (also loads a bvec2)
api.glProgramUniform3i: zoo cell + readback; negative control turns a cell red
api.glProgramUniformMatrix2fv: zoo cell (column-major) + readback; array of two mat2
api.glUniform3f: writes to the pipeline's active program (readback of three programs, pixels), to the glUseProgram program when one is current, INVALID_OPERATION without an active program or for a location the active program lacks
api.glUseProgram: overrides the bound pipeline for drawing (solid cell) and for glUniform* (readback); CURRENT_PROGRAM and PROGRAM_PIPELINE_BINDING; INVALID_OPERATION for a program whose link failed
api.glGetUniformfv: values stored by glProgramUniform*/glUniform* read back exactly from programs that are not current
api.glGetUniformiv: integer, bool and array values read back exactly
api.glGetUniformuiv: unsigned values including 0x80000001 and 0xFFFFFFFF read back exactly
api.glGetUniformLocation: struct member, struct array and array element names resolved in the zoo program
api.glGetProgramInfoLog: the compile-failure program's log contains the shader's compile log
api.glDeleteProgram: a program that is the stage program of a pipeline is only flagged (IsProgram TRUE, DELETE_STATUS TRUE, still used for drawing) and deleted when the pipeline releases it
api.glIsProgram: TRUE while flagged for deletion and referenced by a pipeline, FALSE afterwards
api.glDrawArrays: one triangle per cell through the pipeline under test; invalid pipelines raise INVALID_OPERATION

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi capture viewed 1:1 and zoomed (llvmpipe/zink differ by at most 1 per channel): rows 0-2 show 18 coloured scene cells as listed in the README (A0 red|olive, A1 blue mirrored to the right, A2/A3 horizontal splits, A4-A7 green|magenta and yellow|magenta from the two-stage program, B0-B7 uniform and precedence cells incl. the solid orange glUseProgram cell, C0 periwinkle/teal, C4 violet|olive); cells 17-19 and 21-23 are empty dark gray as intended (invalid pipelines are rejected); rows 3-7 show 38 green zoo cells and two dark cells.
